name: omarchy-controller
author: Aditya Bhatnagar
description: Console-style game controller support in the bar: see every connected PlayStation, Xbox, Switch or generic pad with player number and battery, pair new ones over Bluetooth with per-brand instructions, and open a live controller map that lights up as you press buttons and shows what each one does in games.

barWidget.description: Connected controllers, Bluetooth pairing and a live button map
